method: Installed code-reviewer common method; read-only fixed-commit review
scope: External R1/F-02 and F-01 repair, direct installation dependencies, affected documentation, regression meaning and necessity

findings.evidence: Verified old members absent from the new candidate require cleanup or explicit preservation before preview or cleanup. Omission reports the exact path; unknown custom/history files remain outside mandatory classification.

Traced execute(apply) through real cleanup, nested plan/apply and final observation. Only an ordinary directory that is a candidate-member ancestor is accepted at a retired file path; files, linked paths and unrelated directories remain rejected.

test_necessity.conclusion: No unnecessary restrictive case or additional broad matrix identified in the affected scope.
test_necessity.transition_rows: Candidate directory, file remnant and unrelated directory test distinct final-state branches; the apply test replaces the previous preview-only test.
test_necessity.ownership_rows: Omitted, cleanup and keep test distinct owner dispositions and refusal before preview or mutation.
test_necessity.retained_cases: Unremoved parent collision protects pre-cleanup admission. The 4097-history boundary directly covers OWN-06.
test_necessity.relaxed_assertion: Replaced exact read-call count with no reads of unrelated history/custom bytes; permits legitimate implementation changes.

documentation: Explicit keep leaves new lock management and may retain runtime discovery or broken references. Missing managed files remain drift. Existing response fields explain plan classification without a new schema.
limitations: Reviewer performed static read-only review and did not execute tests, installation, provider writes or a security scan.
Regression fixtures execute the outer reinstallation wrapper and filesystem effects; nested installer and external engine/candidate/Git admission remain controlled dependencies.
No new packaged acceptance, real-project installation, hosted CI or publication is claimed.
Original independent-review.json and native-validation.json retain their earlier subjects; this record supplements rather than rewrites them.
